rules.name: Limited Resources
rules.description: All CAS exist as individual Battle Groups and are not required to follow the standard rules for Battle Group creation. Whilst they are not Specialist Battle Groups, they are restricted by the sie of the Fleet they are attached to. Therefore a single CAS can be included in a Fleet for every FULL 1250 Points being played.

rules.name: Cathedral of the Faithful
rules.description: Each Section on a CAS can replace ONE of its listed Boarding Craft with a Zealot for NO POINTS! This bonus is in addition to the standard number of Zealots available to a Fleet.

rules.name: Seraph Hosts
rules.description: All Seraph Interceptor Wings launched by a CAS increase their maximum size to 6 rather than the normal 5.

rules.name: Focused Wrath
rules.description: All Plasma Cannon Array Attacks made by this Element may re-roll a single Attack Dice for each friendly Zealot on-board.

rules.name: Unique Ability - Rho 'Barutamee
rules.description: ho 'Barutamee is a skilled military leader and an excellent tactician. He can therefore choose to re-roll the initiative Dice each turn, but the second result MUST be accepted.

rules.name: Hunter Killers
rules.description: All Elements in this Battle Group may re-roll any Initial Rolls of a "SKULL" when firing Plasma Torpedoes at Short Range.

rules.name: Command Centre
rules.description: A Fleet containing a Golden Path Battle Group may reroll a Single Order Dice at the begining of either the Attacks or Boarding Segments (but not both!)

rules.name: Unique Ability - Xytan 'Jar Wattinree
rules.description: A gifted military opportunist, Xytan 'Jar Wattniree is capable of taking advantage of the slightest flaw in an opponent's plan. During the Execute Orders step of the Orders Phase he can force the opponent to re-roll a single Order Dice each turn, but the second result MUST be accepted.

rules.name: Unique Ability - Covenant Generic Fleet Commander
rules.description: Once per Game Turn, the Covenant Commander may re-roll their bording D6 when Attacking an enemy Formation during a Boarding Action. The second result must be accepted.

rules.name: Unique Ability - Minister of Etiology
rules.description: Whilst utterly self-possed and concerned only with politics, the Minister claims a high rank within the covenant Hierarchy and can bend even Fleet Commanders to his will. After any Inital Order Dice have been rolled during the Order Dice Phase, the Minister may change a SINGLE friendly Covenant Order Dice to be any result.

characteristics.name: Effect

characteristics.name: Use

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Remove ALL Vunerable Markers from a Capital Element in the Fleet.

characteristics.name: Use

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: An Element may reroll up to TWO Attack Dice. These dice may only be rerolled once.

characteristics.name: Use
characteristics.$text: This Order is issued after any inital dice are rolled either the attack segment or the boarding resolution phase.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: The Fleet Commander may order the rebuilding of a Battle Group up to a maximum of BR of 6. See the Adhoc Battle Groups rules in the rulebook.

characteristics.name: Use
characteristics.$text: This Order may be issued during the Execute Orders Step of the Order Dice Phase.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: The Covenant Fleet automatically gain the Initative this Turn.

characteristics.name: Use
characteristics.$text: This order may be issued during the Execute Orders Step of the Order Dice Phase.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: An Element may re-roll a SINGLE inital Defence Array die rolled by an element. This dice may only be re-rolled once.

characteristics.name: Use
characteristics.$text: This Order may be issued after any inital Defence Dice Pool Roll.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Roll a Halo Dice - on a roll of any result other than a "SKULL", the Minister may be placed on a nearby friendly vessel within 12". Should the Minister roll a "SKULL" when trying to escape, or have no friendly Formation Base within 12" however, the Minister is removed from the game and the enemy Fleet gains an additional +4 VPs.

characteristics.name: Use
characteristics.$text: The Minister of Etiology is never without an escape plan. Should the Element containing the Minister be Destroyed.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: The Minister may force an enemy Firing Solutio targeting his own formation base to retarget a different member of his Battle Group - even if a loadout would require his formation base to be the nominated base (Missile Barrage, for example).

characteristics.name: Use
characteristics.$text: This Order must be issued after the formation containing the Minister is declared the target of a firing solution.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Increase the security Detail rating of ALL zealots in a Fleet by +2 for the remainder of the Turn.

characteristics.name: Use

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Increase the Firepower Rating of a Defensive Roll made by a Capital Ship by +1 this turn.

characteristics.name: Use
characteristics.$text: This Order must be issued after a Capital Element has been targeted by an enemy attack.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: An Element may increase the number of Attack Dice rolled in a Secondary Weapon Attack by +2.

characteristics.name: Use
characteristics.$text: This Order must be issued prior to any Inital Dice Roll.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: The Element may remove a single Vulnerable Marker allocated to it.

characteristics.name: Use
characteristics.$text: This Order must be executed during the Execute Orders Step of the Order Dice Phase of a Turn.

sharedRules.name: [AS] Assault Specialist
sharedRules.description: Elements with the Assault Specialist Loadout may elect to add or deduct the Value shown in parenthesis from the result on the Boarding Result Table. If both sides involved in a Boarding Action have the Assault Specialist Loadout they cancel each other out irrespective of the Values involved.

sharedRules.name: [CA] Carrier Action
sharedRules.description:
Elements with the Carrier Action (Value) Loadout may re-launch a number of Wings equal to the Value listed in their Loadout's parenthesis during the End Phase. The Wing or Wings are immediately deployed within 8" of their Formation Base.

Wings deployed in this manner must be formed into a legal Wing and they may only be taken from the casualties in the Faction's Scrapyard.
FAQ Example: If a player has a mix of 9 Flight Tokens in their scrapyard and an Element has a Carrier Action (2) Loadout, ALL the Flight Tokens can return to battle but MUST be formed into 1 or 2 legal Wings.

sharedRules.name: [CS] Cloaking System
sharedRules.description: An Element with this Loadout causes enemy Attacks to suffer -1 to their Firepower Rating when firing at Long Range.

sharedRules.name: [DA] Defence Array
sharedRules.description: An Element with the Defence Arrays (Value) Loadout may add the Value listed in Parathesis to its Defence Dice Pool when defending against Attack by the enemy or when colliding with Terrain.

sharedRules.name: [E] Elusive
sharedRules.description: An Element with the Elusive Loadout causes any attack made by an enemy Element against it to suffer a -1 to its Firepower Rating. However, if the attacker is a Bomber Wing on an Attack Run, or if ALL Elements initiating the Firing Solution at the target also have the Elusive Loadout, this modifier is ignored.

sharedRules.name: [G] Glide
sharedRules.description:
Elements with the Glide (Distance") Loadout may forgo their standard Movement to move laterally (sideways) instead. The distance they may travel is denote in parenthesis. An Element using its Glide Loadout may not make any Turning Action during its Movement.
FAQ: A Formation Base using Glide MUST move the full Distance listed on the Loadout Entry and may NOT elect to execute a Glide while occupying Terrain that might cause the Formation Damage.

sharedRules.name: [HS] Heroic Save
sharedRules.description:
If at any time a Token with the Heroic Save (Type) Loadout should be called upon to be removed as a casualty, roll a single Halo Dice and refer to the Type listed in parenthesis.

>Spartans: on a roll of anything other than a "SKULL", the Spartan Token remains in play and is NOT removed as a casualty.

>Zealots: on a roll of a "1" or "2", the ZZealot Token remains in play and is NOT removed as a casualty.

>Troopers: on a roll of a "2", the Trooper Token is NOT removed as a casualty.

sharedRules.name: [L] Labyrinthine
sharedRules.description: Elements with the Labyrinthine Loadout ALWAYS reduce the result rolled on the Boarding Result Table by 2. This is applied after all other loadouts have taken effect.

sharedRules.name: [P*] Penitents*
sharedRules.description: Security Details on this Element are considered to have the Assault Specialist (1) Loadout.

sharedRules.name: [PD*] All Point Defence
sharedRules.description: All ADP Escort Formations in a Battle Group can add their Point Defence to that of ANY Capital Element in the same Battle Group, but ONLY when the Capital Element is attacked by weapons with the Missiles Loadout.

sharedRules.name: [PD] Point Defence
sharedRules.description:
This Loadout represents weapons most commonly used to defend against Bombers and Boarding Craft that are performing Attack Runs or Boarding Assaults against a target Element.

In addition, Point Defence systems can also be used to defend against attacks made by Elements with the Missile Weapons Loadout. In all cases, the value inside the parenthesis is the number of Dice added to an elements Defence Dice Pool Prior to rolling.

sharedRules.name: Assigned
sharedRules.description: This Heroic Character must be assigned to a specific Formation Base within the Fleet at the start of the battle.

sharedRules.name: Beam
sharedRules.description:
Beam Weapons are Short Range cutting ordnance that can target multiple Elements at once. These weapons may NEVER take part in firing solutions with any other weapon - they are simply too powerful and unpredictable to use with other weapons in concenrated fire.

Beam Weapons are fired in the following manner:

>Nominate a Primary Target as normal and allocate the first number in the Dice Profile for the weapon to it.

>Then nominate a different Element within 6" of the first and allocate the second number in the Dice Profile to that Element.
Note: Unlike normal Firing Solutions, this Target does NOT have to be part of the same Battle Group as any other target.

>Finally, nominate a different third target within 6" of the second and allocate the third number in the Dice Profile to that target.
Note: Unlike normal Firing Solutions, this Target does NOT have to be part of the same Battle Group as any other target.

Each of these models targeted by the Beam Weapon is attacked and resolved separatley. This loadout DOE NOT permit the weapon to fire at a target that is beyond its stated range or Arc of Fire.

Due to the overwhelming power of Beam weapons, the Attack Dice Pools use a starting Firepower Rating 5 as default. The effects of terrain and Loadouts are still applicable.

sharedRules.name: Missiles
sharedRules.description: Elements with the Missile Loadout gain a +1 on their Firepower Rating when firing at targets at Long Range. In addition, Elements defending against Missile Weapons may add the value in their Point Defence (Value) Loadout when constructing a Defence Dice Pool.

sharedRules.name: Plasma
sharedRules.description: All Plasma-based weapons irrespective of their type gain a +1 to the Firepower Rating at Short Range and a -1 at Long Range.

sharedRules.name: [H] High Value Target**
sharedRules.description: This Element is considered to have a build rating of one less than listed for the purpose of fleet building.

sharedRules.name: [HK] Hidden Killer
sharedRules.description: Any Primary (P) Ranged Attack made against this Vessel from more than 20" away suffers a further -1 to its Firepower rating.
